_about: PARKED. The energy family of ../m0-rich.md section 4 (wave 5 in its table; the EP's wave 6). Not loaded, not hashed. Emitters and shapes come from moveset.antihero.m0.json. Travel speeds and ranges are Combat's proposals for Encounter and Game Design. Unless a line says it is Legal's, the Legal lines are Combat's proposals.

rules.mode: energy mode swaps the piece family: the same entries and body poses, with a hand and an emission (ADR 0008)
rules.weight: the shape sets it: bolt, volley and shard are lights; arc, burst, lob and charged are heavies
rules.class: blast: a wind-up of 15 ticks for a light and 20 for a heavy; a perfect block in its window deflects it; a Guard at range may deflect one for 10 ki
rules.damage: the shape carries the strike's damage and never adds to it; a volley or the shards split it (Game Design's barrage ruling). The volley opener and the poke are 3 at 4 each
rules.sim: a blast is a scheduled impact: its arrival tick and a strike. The projectile is render-only: an event with the origin, the target, the travel ticks, the shape and the count
rules.miss: a blast that misses strikes near the target's feet with the ordinary area damage
rules.aura: only while charging or attacking: a thin outline or rings in his lane colour; no flame, no lightning, no gold, white or red

volley.look: three darts in a flat fan
volley._legal: a fan from one sweep of the arm or one flick of the hand: never both palms pumping forward in turn

shard.look: five hexagonal flakes that tumble and spread: his barrage

arc.look: a crescent thrown off a limb that is already swinging; it is wide and crosses the lane
arc._legal: it leaves a limb in motion: no held pose before it

burst.look: a flat hexagonal ring that opens at the point of contact and pushes

lob.look: a hexagonal slab lobbed on a high arc; it lands with an area
lob._legal: a slab, never a sphere; thrown with one hand, never raised overhead in two

charged.look: one long lance after a visible charge
charged._legal: the charge is plates stacking along the forearm, never a ball of light growing in a palm; the arm is drawn back at shoulder height, never to the hip

open_palm.look: flat, fingers together, the arm out at chest height
open_palm._legal: never at the hip; no palm-forward charge pose with a scream

pinch.look: thumb to forefinger; the dart leaves as they part
pinch._legal: no pointing finger and no two-finger point

clawed_palm.look: fingers spread and hooked like tines

fist_glow.look: a closed fist with the forearm plates lit along their edges
fist_glow._legal: lit plate edges, not a ball of light round the fist

blade_hand.look: a flat knife hand; darts run off its edge

crossed_forearms.look: the two forearm guards brought together, plates outward
crossed_forearms._legal: in motion, never a held crossed-arms pose

emitters.look: The backhand's sweep throws the crescent off the forearm plate, or scatters the fan along its arc.
The palm stops a hand short of the rival and the dart leaves it; at point-blank the same push ends in the ring.
The thrust becomes the line the darts follow, running off the edge of the hand.
The rising fist drags a crescent up from below, or scoops the slab up to fall on the rival.
The downward chop cuts a crescent straight down; struck into the ground, it is the ring.
The looping arm lets the slab go at the top of its arc; up close, the same loop ends in the ring.
Both blade hands thrust a hand apart, and the darts or flakes leave from the two edges together.
Both forearm guards come down side by side and the ring opens where they land.
The crescent leaves the shin at the widest point of the kick.
The heel's drop cuts a crescent downward.
The ring opens at the knee as it lands.
The tail's tip flicks a dart, or sheds flakes, without his hands moving.
The lash throws a crescent, or a fan, off its end.

poses: charge: side-on, the firing arm drawn back at shoulder height, hexagonal plates stacking along the forearm, the other hand open on the firing arm's shoulder
release: the arm straight at the rival, blade hand, the plates gone
emitters.look: One arm, one shot: the plates stack along the forearm and leave as a lance, or a single quick dart with no charge.

poses: charge: one forearm high and one low, plates facing each other across a body-length gap, hexagonal plates stacking along the line between them
release: the arms torn apart, the lance leaving along that line
emitters.look: Two arms: the lance forms along the line between a high forearm and a low one, and leaves when he tears them apart.
emitters._legal: Legal (rule-of-cool-screen.md, wave 2 section): hands at least a shoulder width apart, or one high and one low, never wrists together; never cupped at either hip, never drawn back to one hip and thrust forward; no sphere or glow forming between facing palms, and no hands overhead holding a growing orb; no palms-forward double thrust from the chest as the release; the stacking rule applies while he channels

poses: the turn: three-quarters away, looking back over the shoulder, the hand flicking behind him
emitters.look: He is already leaving; the darts are flicked back over his shoulder without a full turn.

poses: the release: upright, chin up, hands open and low, the flat shards leaving their ring one after another
emitters.look: The shards that circle him fire on their own: he does not raise a hand.
emitters._legal: Combat's proposal: flat shards on a slow tilted ring: no halo of light behind the head and no orbiting spheres; the stacking rule applies

poses: the shove: a flat palm at chest height, the arm at full length, body side-on behind it
emitters.look: A push with no damage: the ring opens off the flat palm and the rival slides back.
emitters._legal: Combat's proposal: the palm is at chest height on a straight arm, never at the hip
